svg.title: Pi TimeLens Step summaries in a real Pi terminal session
svg.desc: A faithful transcript redraw from Pi 0.85.1 at 120 columns. TimeLens separates response latency from strict text TTFT, summarizes two parallel tools, then shows one request Total with elapsed time, model time, tool time, tokens, and cache.
svg.metadata: Faithful redraw of tests/fixtures/real-pi-120.txt, selected from a real Pi 0.85.1 TUI session at 120 columns on 2026-09-09. Raw capture SHA-256: a8f3ea3b0c8cbc971eef8517826c9d5366f050854e4c2a5765d5429124bd23c3. Transcript text, wrapping, ordering, measured values, and theme roles are preserved; startup, transient working/status UI, update notice, footer, model identifier, filesystem path, and assistant reasoning are omitted.

g.text: Pi TimeLens · faithful Pi 0.85.1 transcript · 120 columns
Use the read tool to read auth.ts and config.ts in one parallel tool batch. Do not call any other tools. Then reply
